governance.purpose: Defensive red-team simulation — how opponents would attack Kelly Grappe. Not for staff distribution without candidate approval. No fabricated court records; verification queue explicit.
governance.simulationDisclaimer: HAMMER_SIM and PACKO_SIM blocks are opponent-posture planning exercises, not verified quotes or approved campaign messages.

hiddenPathway.triggerContextHint: Appears once in county-clerk copy on intelligence hub — same color as body text, not bolded.

researchDossier.summary: Deeper Kelly-facing research queue than Packo scaffold or Hammer KH modules — prioritize court/ethics/paper/petition ties before debate.

verificationLegend.VERIFIED: Primary source in repo or named URL captured
verificationLegend.PARTIAL: Campaign narrative only — opponent will still search
verificationLegend.NEEDS_RESEARCH: Must be run before Kelly cites or denies on stage
verificationLegend.NOT_FOUND: No record in repo — do not imply guilt; prepare denial or pivot

findings.title: Criminal / civil court records (Arkansas + federal)
whatOpponentsWillSearch: Arkansas CourtConnect / county circuit search — Kelly Grappe, Steve Grappe
Small-claims, eviction, lien filings tied to farm or market
findings.knownInRepo: No criminal conviction logged in campaign data — absence is not proof; run search.
findings.attackPotential: HIGH if any hit; LOW if clean search logged
findings.kellyRule: Never deny categorically without search completed this cycle; use 'happy to discuss verified public record' only if counsel clears.

findings.title: Judgments, tax liens, UCC filings
whatOpponentsWillSearch: business entity standing for Forevermost / market
findings.knownInRepo: Farm economics stress post-COVID noted in biography — not a judgment.
findings.kellyRule: If clean: pivot to small-business survival story. If hit: counsel + single-sentence factual response only.

findings.title: Newspaper, radio, TV, op-eds attributable to Kelly
whatOpponentsWillSearch: Arkansas Democrat-Gazette, Arkansas Times, KUAR, Talk Business
Stand Up Arkansas blog / Regnat Populus letters (Steve and Kelly Grappe)
Forevermost farm blog essays (transparency, politics metaphors)
findings.knownInRepo: Biography cites KUAR Dec 2023, Arkansas Times, For AR Kids press; LEARNS referendum role; 'Waiting for the Pot to Boil' essay.
findings.attackPotential: HIGH — long paper trail on petitions and movement politics
findings.kellyRule: Own civics leadership; separate SOS-administrator role from activist chapter; decline circulating petitions during race (already public stance).

findings.title: Ballot petitions & initiative logistics Kelly can be tied to
whatOpponentsWillSearch: For AR Kids / Educational Rights Amendment — 68 counties organized, 55 county mins, statewide total missed (per Regnat Populus letter in repo)
Sherwood duplex logistics hub — central petition operations
Any 2026 refiling plans mentioned in movement correspondence
findings.knownInRepo: Documented in ask-kelly-public biography Parts IV–V; Hammer camp will contrast with petition-restriction bills.
findings.attackPotential: CRITICAL in SOS debate — Hammer's strongest alignment
findings.kellyRule: Agree integrity + lawful participation; contrast unfunded mandates; never attack petition rights; verify county counts before stage.

findings.title: Stand Up Arkansas leadership & training ecosystem
findings.knownInRepo: Kelly helps lead; Recruit-Train-Activate; multiple external training URLs; Democrat ID with people-over-politics framing.
findings.kellyRule: Civic education is SOS duty; nonprofit work shows democracy skill; office will be non-partisan in administration.

findings.title: No statewide SOS administration tenure
findings.knownInRepo: scenario opp-kelly-unprepared-attack; coaching layer for first debate vs 25+ year opponent.
findings.kellyRule: Service desk frame; 75 counties; implementation vs sponsorship; rehearse 30s answers.

findings.title: Democratic nominee in non-partisan office rhetoric
findings.knownInRepo: Biography states Democrat; campaign stresses non-partisan administration.
findings.kellyRule: Lean unity themes tested in independent/Republican rooms; equal rules for every county.

findings.title: Steve Grappe co-signer / co-organizer attribution
whatOpponentsWillSearch: Regnat Populus letters signed Steve and Kelly
findings.knownInRepo: Joint signature on movement letters; Forevermost co-operators.
findings.kellyRule: Acknowledge partnership; Kelly is candidate; SOS accountability is hers alone.

findings.title: Forevermost commercial pause post-COVID
findings.knownInRepo: Honest pivot after cost shocks; transparency narrative.
findings.kellyRule: Resilience story; same lesson as funding election infrastructure; not a shutdown — storytelling continues.

findings.title: LEARNS / For AR Kids signature shortfall narrative
whatOpponentsWillSearch: Missed statewide threshold despite county mins
litigation / AG delay themes in letters
findings.knownInRepo: 55 of 50 counties with mins but total missed — per biography ingest.
findings.kellyRule: Scale of organizing proof; humility on shortfall; SOS office will professionalize logistics — not relitigate LEARNS vote on stage unless asked.

findings.title: First debate — composure, memory, citation discipline
findings.knownInRepo: Explicit first-debate coaching; trap lanes; do-not-say.
findings.kellyRule: Use if-stuck scripts; claims gate; never match Hammer volume.

hammerRedTeam.strategicObjective: Frame race as security vs chaos; make Kelly look like activist petition organizer unfit to administer laws she fought to circumvent; protect 2021–2025 legislative record as SOS-ready experience.
offensiveDebatePlan: Open with check-my-record — rapid bill/act citations
Invite Kelly into petition-hypocrisy trap: SOS neutrality vs Sherwood hub history
Force experience contrast: Senate specialist vs first-time debater
Use Packo as implicit ally on reform without naming coordination
Close on integrity ranking / fraud prosecution themes — NEEDS_REVIEW before Hammer cites
defensiveDebatePlan: Agree on abstract integrity; refuse motive claims without sources
County champion lane if Kelly attacks clerks — pivot to unfunded mandates with one bill
Decline biography bait — 15s pivot to acts
Never ask Packo to vote for Hammer on stage

attackVectors.label: No SOS experience
likelyLines: She's never run a statewide election office.
Telecom manager isn't Secretary of State.
attackVectors.trapSetup: Moderator: qualifications segment — let Kelly over-explain biography.

attackVectors.label: Petition organizer vs SOS gatekeeper
likelyLines: She ran central petition warehouses — now wants to administer the rules?
For AR Kids couldn't finish the job — why trust her with statewide logistics?
Stand Up Arkansas trains activists — not clerks.
attackVectors.trapSetup: Ask Kelly if she will make ballot access harder after LEARNS fight.

attackVectors.label: Democrat activist SOS
likelyLines: Democrat nominee with Stand Up Arkansas training hubs.
Jim Crow at-large rhetoric — radical organizer.
People over politics — but which people?
attackVectors.trapSetup: Culture-war lane if Kelly sounds partisan while claiming unity.

attackVectors.label: Personal / biography bait
likelyLines: Farm failed — can she run government?
Husband co-wrote movement letters — who's in charge?

rebuttalToKelly: When Kelly cites county burden: agree clerks matter → contrast her lack of implementation plan → cite Hammer bill without funding follow-through question back to her.
When Kelly uses unity spine: agree transparency → ask for act number on Civic Index claim → NEEDS_REVIEW.
When Kelly agrees on fraud: narrow agreement → list enforcement bills → ask what she would defund.
hardCoreTakedownSequence: Minute 0–3: Establish authority with three act numbers.
Minute 3–8: Pull Kelly into petition thread; let Packo echo access.
Minute 8–12: Experience trap + check my record.
Minute 12+: If Kelly strong on clerks, culture-war bait; if weak, press unprepared narrative.

packoRedTeam.strategicObjective: Own reform/anti-establishment lane; position as neither Capitol insider nor Democratic activist; peel protest vote from Kelly in suburbs; occasionally align with Hammer on access skepticism without endorsing him.
offensiveDebatePlan: Sound reasonable on election reform — ranked choice, competitiveness
Attack duopoly: R vs D same establishment
Question Kelly's petition-organizer credibility vs Libertarian consistency
Let Hammer be the attack dog — Packo stays calm reformer
defensiveDebatePlan: Deflect SOS implementation questions — economist not clerk
No quote ledger yet — stay high-level
If Kelly attacks Packo: welcome reform debate, cite pakko4ar.com

attackVectors.label: Duopoly / anything-but-D
likelyLines: Kelly is the Democratic machine choice.
Why trust a petition professional to be impartial?
Hammer wrote rules; Kelly organized protests — Packo offers independence.
attackVectors.trapSetup: Agree with Hammer on one narrow point; isolate Kelly in third position.

attackVectors.label: Reform lane theft
likelyLines: Kelly talks transparency after missing signature thresholds.
Real reform isn't Stand Up training modules — it's competitive elections.
attackVectors.trapSetup: When Kelly speaks third — agree with prior speakers then add reform zinger.

rebuttalToKelly: When Kelly bridges to counties: agree → ask why Democrat activist trusts Libertarian-leaning clerks more than Packo.
When Kelly cites telecom: concede business exp → ask about public-sector exp.
hardCoreTakedownSequence: Do not attack Kelly first — let Hammer soften her.
Enter on reform + independence when moderator asks open question.
Never endorse Hammer; never ask voters to vote Kelly.

counterPlaybook.summary: Combat every attack vector with agree-plus-fresh-add, claims gate, and trap-lane pivots.

responses.kellyAcknowledge: Senator Hammer has years in the legislature — I respect that.
responses.kellyContrast: Writing election law is not the same as running the Secretary of State's office for seventy-five counties every day.
responses.kellyBridge: I am running to be the statewide help desk for clerks — training, published rules, funding advocacy.

responses.kellyAcknowledge: I believe Arkansans should be able to petition their government — I helped organize that work.
responses.kellyContrast: The SOS race is why I am not circulating petitions personally this year — fairness matters.
responses.kellyBridge: As Secretary of State I will publish clear rules, support clerks, and protect both integrity and lawful participation.
responses.claimsGate: Verify For AR Kids county numbers before citing; do not relitigate LEARNS unless moderator asks.

responses.kellyAcknowledge: I am the Democratic nominee — I will not hide that.
responses.kellyContrast: This office must administer elections for every party equally — that is the job.
responses.kellyBridge: Transparency, accountability, and cross-aisle work for clerks — tested in independent and Republican rooms.
responses.claimsGate: Unity themes field-tested; Civic Index rank NEEDS_REVIEW before air.

responses.kellyAcknowledge: I am proud of our farm and our community work.
responses.kellyContrast: I am running for Secretary of State — not a talk show.
responses.kellyBridge: Let's talk about acts, counties, and what clerks need — in ten seconds.
responses.claimsGate: 15s decline script from culture-war trap lane.

responses.kellyAcknowledge: Dr. Packo raises fair questions about competition in our politics.
responses.kellyContrast: Secretary of State is a service job — seventy-five counties need implementation, not theory alone.
responses.kellyBridge: I will show up for clerks with published guidance and funding advocacy.
responses.claimsGate: No Packo attack until PACKO-02 quote ledger partial.
doNotSay: Vote for me instead of Packo on stage
